    Retrieve WCVP distribution data for a set of plant taxa

    wcvp_distribution_list.Rd

    Retrieves WCVP distribution records for each taxon supplied in `taxon_queries`, returning a list of data frames. Each element corresponds to one taxon and contains its WCVP distribution information, annotated with the supplied plant name and (optionally) known and predicted host status. Taxa for which no distribution records are available produce a warning and return `NULL` for that list element.

    wcvp_distribution_list(
  taxon_queries,
  plant_names = taxon_queries,
  known_hosts = NULL,
  pred_hosts = NULL,
  wcvp_names,
  wcvp_distributions,
  ...
)

    Arguments

    taxon_queries

    Character vector of taxon names to query. Must contain unique values.

    plant_names

    Character vector of plant names to assign to the returned records (via the `plant_sp` column). Must be the same length as `taxon_queries`, and must also contain unique values. If not set, taxon names are used directly.

    known_hosts

    Optional character vector of known host species. Used to assign a logical `known_host` column. Defaults to `NULL`.

    pred_hosts

    Optional character vector of predicted host species. Used to assign a logical `pred_host` column. Defaults to `NULL`.

    wcvp_names

    WCVP names data frame.

    wcvp_distributions

    WCVP distribution data frame.

    ...

    Additional arguments forwarded to `get_wcvp_distribution()`, and ultimately to `rWCVP::wcvp_distribution()`.

    Value

    A list of data frames, one per taxon, containing WCVP distribution records. Elements may be `NULL` where no distribution data were found.

    Details

    This function relies on an internal helper (`get_wcvp_distribution()`) which wraps [rWCVP::wcvp_distribution()] and handles annotation of species names and host status.

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
wcvp_distribution_list(
  taxon_queries = c("Quercus robur", "Quercus petraea"),
  known_hosts = c("Quercus robur"),
  pred_hosts = NULL,
  wcvp_names = wcvp_v10_names,
  wcvp_distributions = wcvp_v10_distributions
)
} # }
